name: farn-theme
description: A token-first CSS design system rooted in the forests of northern Germany — palette + semantic tokens, plus ready-to-use component classes
author: Jacob Lueg Tiedemann <bo@jbpt.de>

scripts.build: cat tokens/colors.css tokens/typography.css tokens/spacing.css tokens/motion.css tokens/dark-light.css tokens/components.css > dist/farn-tokens.css && cat dist/farn-tokens.css tokens/base.css > dist/farn.css && cat tokens/components.css tokens/component-classes.css > dist/farn-components.css && cat tokens/typography-classes.css > dist/farn-typography.css && cat tokens/layout.css > dist/farn-layout.css && cp llms.txt site/public/llms.txt && cp site/src/scripts/tabs.js dist/tabs.js && cp site/src/scripts/nav.js dist/nav.js
